Frontend Engineer - Mossgate Software

About the role
Mossgate builds scheduling software for service businesses and is hiring for its frontend team. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Build customer-facing React features
- Collaborate with designers
- Write automated tests

Requirements
- React in production
- TypeScript
- CSS and responsive layout
- Jest testing
- Accessibility practice

Nice to have
- Next.js

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
